faqs.q: How can I download the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: You can download the Service NSW app to manage your digital licences and credentials.

faqs.q: How do I add a digital licence or credential to the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: You can add various digital licences and credentials, such as your Working with Children Check or Seniors Card, directly to the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: How can I check my digital driver licence?
faqs.a: You can check your NSW Digital Driver Licence status using the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: What can I check in the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: You can check various items, including a digital trade licence, a NSW Digital Photo Card (Trial), or your Working with Children Check status.
